model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the number of participants associated with each criterion. The horizontal axis, labeled “Criterion,” displays the categories in alphabetical order: “Filters”, “Veracity Explanation”, “Relevance Explanation”, “Overall Summary”, “Clarity and Simplicity”, “FC Summary”, and “FCs”. The vertical axis, labeled “Number of Participants,” extends from 0 to 6 and uses a linear scale with tick marks every 1 unit.  The bar representing “FCs” is the tallest, reaching a value of 6, while the bars representing “Filters”, “Veracity Explanation”, “Relevance Explanation”, “Overall Summary”, “Clarity and Simplicity”, and “FC Summary” each extend to a value of 3, 3, 2, 2, 3, and 5, respectively.  All bars are shaded in varying shades of purple and green, and no bars are visually emphasized.
